answer: Rate-limit identities by a rotating memory-hard proof: each epoch an agent must solve a 2 GB puzzle in under 90 seconds, and the puzzle seed is drawn from a public beacon only at the summit of the epoch. Every extra fake needs another 2 GB of RAM, so copper-cheap clones hit a hardware wall; verifiers check each solution in milliseconds, and karst-like gaps in uptime forfeit that epoch's reward.
